7 EMAIL MARKETING METRIC
+ TIPS ON HOW TO INCREASE OR DECREASE THEM ON COMMAND
From a $200M+ email marketer - Chase Dimond
OPEN RATE
• This metric shows the percentage of recipients who opened your email.
• It measures the effectiveness of your subject line and preview text.
To boost it, craft intriguing, compelling subject lines and preview texts.
CONVERSION RATE
This metric shows the percentage of recipients who bought after clicking through your
email. It directly correlates with revenue.
To boost it, optimize your emails and landing pages for conversions.
CLICK-THROUGH RATE
This metric shows the percentage of recipients who clicked a link in your email. It reveals
how enticing your CTAs are.
To boost it, make your CTAs clear, concise, and compelling.
BOUNCE RATE
This metric shows the percentage of undeliverable emails. It reflects the health of your
email list.
To reduce it, keep your list clean and up-to-date by removing unengaged subscribers.
UNSUBSCRIBE RATE
This metric shows the percentage of recipients who unsubscribe. It reflects how relevant and
engaging your emails are.
To reduce it, ensure your content is valuable to subscribers.
REVENUE PER SUBSCRIBER
This metric shows the revenue generated per email subscriber. It helps you understand
each subscriber's value.
To boost it, send more targeted offers and promotions.
ABANDONED CHECKOUT RATE
This metric shows how many customers started but didn't complete their
purchases. It helps you understand why they abandon.
To reduce it, offer incentives and reminders to complete the purchase.
Bookmark this and follow Chase Dimond for more great tips.

Quadro de sete métricas de e-mail e orientações de melhoria apresentadas pela peça.
